description:
Seolsuk is the daughter of a lowly provincial worker, and due to her quick wit and tack, she worked as an errand girl for the legitimate spouse of the noble in charge of the province. Lady Wi, the mentioned noble's spouse, asks Seolsuk to become Jinhyo, her adopted son's concubine. Seolsuk's heart flutters in being able to marry Jinhyo, who she had been in love with since childhood. However, she finds out that he was already in love with Pilnam, her other childhood friend, which makes her hesitate accepting Lady Wi's offer. On top of that, Seolsuk is chosen to become a "Gifted Maiden," a title given to prospective brides of the emperor. Will Seolsuk survive in the palace and find love in the upcoming turmoil? 

(Source: Copin Comics)
